provenance.prompt:
Create a 5x3 row-major sprite atlas of 15 distinct full-body poses. Character design must be identical to the attached successful Dorian sheet: Dorian Mycel, same clean-shaven compact adult human, warm brown skin, short dense bright purple curls, purple/silver Condas uniform, dark knee pads, purple wristbands, purple/silver shoes. This is the same male athlete, not a teammate or different person. Use no teal, headband, beard, long hair, ponytail, or dark uniform. True transparent RGBA background, all empty pixels transparent; no floor, court, gradient, hoop, ball or props. No clipping and leave clear margins. Crisp 90s arcade pixel-art outline.

Draw an ALLEY-OOP POWER dunk animation. The invisible pass is a separate runtime basketball and must not be drawn; only Dorian appears. 15 frames: runs right, accelerates, plants, launches, rises, catches separate invisible lob with both empty hands overhead at frame 5, tucks and gathers while airborne, then one-handed forceful finish at frame 10, follows through, descends, lands, stands. Fifteen varied connected full-body poses, natural two arms and two legs, identity and outfit match attached Dorian asset exactly.
